# hoop_guardrail (Resource)

Manages a guardrail rule. On the gateway, `input` and `output` inspect the sessions of the connections in `connection_ids`. On a sidecar fleet, `sidecar_spec` is the rule in the sidecar's vocabulary and `sidecar_targets` names the listeners that enforce it. The two halves are independent: a rule may have gateway connections, sidecar listeners, or both.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.

# A guardrail enforced on the gateway, for the sessions of one connection.
resource "hoop_guardrail" "no_drop" {
  name        = "no-drop"
  description = "Refuse DROP statements"

  input = jsonencode({
    rules = [
      { type = "deny_words_list", words = ["DROP"], message = "DROP is not allowed here" }
    ]
  })

  connection_ids = [hoop_connection.pg_prod.id]
}

# The same intent on a sidecar fleet. sidecar_spec is the guardrails block in
# the sidecar's own vocabulary; sidecar_targets names the listeners that run it.
resource "hoop_guardrail" "no_destructive" {
  name        = "no-destructive"
  description = "No destructive statements on the appdb lane"

  sidecar_spec = jsonencode({
    rules = [
      {
        name       = "no-destructive"
        type       = "operation"
        operations = ["delete", "drop", "truncate"]
        message    = "destructive statements are not permitted on appdb"
      }
    ]
  })

  sidecar_targets = [
    # One listener of a sidecar this configuration manages.
    { sidecar_id = hoop_sidecar.payments.id, listener_name = "appdb" },
    # Every listener of a sidecar a service account identity created.
    { sidecar_id = data.hoop_sidecar.gke_eu_ws_123.id },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The unique name of the rule.

### Optional

- `attributes` (List of String) Attribute names this rule is associated with.
- `connection_ids` (List of String) The connections this rule applies to on the gateway.
- `description` (String) The rule description.
- `input` (String) Rules applied to what the user sends, as a JSON object `{"rules": [{"type": "deny_words_list", "words": [...]}]}`. Omit it for a rule with no input checks.
- `output` (String) Rules applied to what the connection returns, in the same shape as `input`. Omit it for a rule with no output checks.
- `sidecar_spec` (String) The rule in the sidecar's own vocabulary, as a JSON object. The control plane places this block on each bound listener. Leave the attribute out to keep the block stored on the gateway; removing a declared value clears it.
- `sidecar_targets` (Attributes List) The sidecar listeners the control plane distributes this rule to. Each entry names a sidecar and one of its listeners, or the whole sidecar when `listener_name` is empty. Leave the attribute out to keep bindings made outside Terraform. Set it to `[]` to unbind the rule from every sidecar. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sidecar_targets))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the resource.

<a id="nestedatt--sidecar_targets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `sidecar_targets`

Required:

- `sidecar_id` (String) The sidecar that enforces the rule.

Optional:

- `listener_name` (String) The listener on that sidecar. Empty binds every listener the sidecar has.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.

terraform import hoop_guardrail.no_drop 30ebf0cd-040e-4c89-9d6e-28f03f472a41
```
